project: hs-manacost reader account v3 and comments
audience: Russian-speaking Hearthstone readers with independent HearthPulse accounts
goals: Implement the approved dark profile screenshot using real saved data

user_journeys.name: Edit profile
user_journeys.success: Open editor, save name/bio/class/avatar through existing versioned API and return to overview

user_journeys.name: Join discussion
user_journeys.success: Consent and publish once; guest sees avatar/name/profile link and verified paid title

direction.name: Manacost twilight profile v3
direction.thesis: A quiet navy frame for the reader's identity and colorful Hearthstone artwork
direction.signature: Gold-edged identity band: avatar/name/bio left, favorite-class crest right
direction.rationale: User chose the existing v3 screenshot; no new art direction or site-wide redesign

typography.display: Existing Roboto Condensed with Arial fallback
typography.utility: Existing Roboto Condensed with Arial fallback
typography.rationale: Keep current site Cyrillic families; no new font download; 38px profile name is an approved screenshot-specific role

shadows.policy: Restrained depth inside account; no shadow-heavy comment cards

responsive.containers: Existing Newspaper 1068/980/740px inner grid; intrinsic account layout and article-width comments; same capabilities on mobile

quality.accessibility: Keyboard, visible focus, labeled controls, status announcements, 44px actions, 4.5:1 body contrast
quality.performance: No added libraries/fonts; fixed avatar geometry; scoped CSS/JS; compare local cold/warm layout and transfer evidence
quality.seo: hs-manacost.ru remains canonical; hs-manacost.com noindex mirror; test.hs-manacost.ru fully noindex
quality.media: Keep existing covers/header/artwork and safe avatar API
quality.ads: No ad slot or view-counter changes
quality.analytics: No staging analytics; no new identity tracking

implementation.dependencies: Existing reader BFF and Newspaper; no native WP accounts/comments

rollout.staging_evidence: Required exact-SHA reader browser suite and live staging shell/login checks; evidence recorded in release task
rollout.approval_owner: Site owner: v3 screenshot explicitly selected
rollout.template_restore: No Cloud Template assignments changed; rollback first-party source only, keep live DB
